parameters.description:
`prowl-relay` accepts an HTTP POST with a native `prowl` payload that includes your Prowl API key (the `apikey` form field). The gateway forwards it to the upstream Prowl API, so you run no messaging infrastructure of your own.

Two channels are available: the free `byok` channel relays your own authenticated payload; the `plus` channel is the metered tier.
parameters.summary: Relay a message through your own Prowl by posting a native Prowl payload to the UnitySVC gateway.
